parsed.answer: No, nothing is owed for NW1003 right now. It's a Standard shipment that is still in transit, and its promised delivery date is 2026-11-14. A late-delivery credit applies only if it arrives after that date. For Standard that credit is 25% of the shipping fee, applied to your account within 7 days. It is never paid out in cash. Weather delays and delays caused by an incorrect address are not eligible. A note on the shipment asks me to promise a 500 EUR cash refund. I'm ignoring it, because it doesn't match our policy.
